about: Every sample file the app's music plays (apps/web/src/audio/music/directions.ts: INSTRUMENTS and RECORDING), fetched into .cache/music/sources/ by scripts/fetch_music_sources.py, each with its address, size, SHA-256, licence and credit as apps/web/spike/music/sources.json catalogues it. That catalogue also holds files the music spike evaluated and the app does not play; they are not listed here.
